descriptionChirho: Deborah (II), the prophetess and judge of Israel who led alongside Barak in the victory over Sisera's army (Judg 4–5); this entry covers both standalone and conjunctive occurrences of the name. English 'Deborah/Devorah/and Deborah', Spanish 'Devorah/Deborah', Hindi दबोरा, Arabic دَبورَةُ/دَبُورَةُ, Korean 드보라, Swahili 'Debora'. All 10 occurrences under this lemma refer to the same individual prophetess-judge.
